text.style: font-size: 8.5px; font-family: 'DejaVu Sans', 'Arial', 'Helvetica', sans-serif; fill: #6b6b66

g.text: to the model changes its prediction by less than 1e-6:

text.style: font-size: 8.5px; font-family: 'DejaVu Sans', 'Arial', 'Helvetica', sans-serif; fill: #6b6b66

g.text: the aggregation stage is exactly permutation invariant

text.style: font-size: 8.5px; font-family: 'DejaVu Sans', 'Arial', 'Helvetica', sans-serif; fill: #6b6b66

g.text: by construction, not just empirically stable.
